name: trial-status-bar
title: Trial status bar
description: A header strip counting the days left in a trial, with a thin progress line and an Upgrade button that gets firmer in the last days and after the end.
docs: startedAt and endsAt are ISO moments, timeZone is the zone days are counted in, and now pins the clock for tests. With four days or more left it reads 'Trial: 12 days left' with the date it ends and an outline Upgrade; from three days on the sentence changes ('Trial ends in 3 days', 'Trial ends tomorrow', 'Trial ends today'), the bar turns solid and Upgrade stands out; after the end it reads 'Your trial has ended' with the same action. Days are calendar days in timeZone, so the number only changes at midnight there. The thin track shows how much of the trial has passed and is hidden from assistive technology. The strip keeps its height until the browser's clock is read, so the page does not jump. onUpgrade is called on press, or give upgradeHref for a link.
